name: trading-research-system
description: Focused trading research skills for Active Market Plan updates, setup scans, trade review, broker reconciliation, and risk checks.

interface.shortDescription: Active plans, setup scans, trade review, and broker-risk workflows.
interface.longDescription: Trading Research System gives Codex a focused skill set for disciplined trading research: maintain an overwriteable Active Market Plan, append update notes, review prior trades during deep updates, analyze current market tape, macro, policy, news, and upcoming events, update momentum rankings, manage setup-level opportunities, apply high-level Al Brooks price action timing, capture post-order and post-exit trade reviews from read-only broker facts, reconcile portfolio exposure across brokers, and review trading statistics.
defaultPrompt: Deep-update my Active Market Plan for next week.
Quick-update today's market plan and setup levels.
Screen stocks for a falling-rate environment.
Review my latest broker execution interactively.
